WITH contacted_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure
  WHERE campaign_id = 19
),
member_spending AS (
  SELECT 
    cm.member_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_spending
  FROM contacted_members cm
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON cm.member_id = m.member_id
  INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
    AND f.channel_code IN ('ST', 'WB')
  GROUP BY cm.member_id
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.member_id) as members_contacted,
  SUM(ms.total_spending) as total_spending
FROM contacted_members cm
LEFT JOIN member_spending ms ON cm.member_id = ms.member_id

WITH contacted_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON ce.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE ce.campaign_id = 19
),
member_spending AS (
  SELECT 
    cm.member_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_spending
  FROM contacted_members cm
  INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.member_key IN (
    SELECT member_key FROM dim_member WHERE member_id = cm.member_id
  )
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
    AND f.channel_code IN ('ST', 'WB')
  GROUP BY cm.member_id
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT cm.member_id) as members_contacted,
  COALESCE(SUM(ms.total_spending), 0) as total_spending
FROM contacted_members cm
LEFT JOIN member_spending ms ON cm.member_id = ms.member_id

WITH contacted_member_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON ce.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE ce.campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT cmi.member_id) as members_contacted,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as total_spending
FROM contacted_member_ids cmi
INNER JOIN dim_member m ON cmi.member_id = m.member_id
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON m.member_key = f.member_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'

-- First, count total contacted members
WITH contacted_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON ce.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE ce.campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
  'Contacted members' as metric,
  COUNT(*) as value
FROM contacted_members
UNION ALL
-- Then sum their spending (including those with 0)
SELECT 
  'Members with purchases' as metric,
  COUNT(DISTINCT cmi.member_id) as value
FROM contacted_members cmi
INNER JOIN dim_member m ON cmi.member_id = m.member_id
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line f ON m.member_key = f.member_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'

-- Final answer query
WITH contacted_member_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure ce
  INNER JOIN dim_member m ON ce.member_key = m.member_key
  WHERE ce.campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacted_member_ids) as members_contacted,
  COALESCE(SUM(f.net_amount), 0) as total_spending_eur
FROM contacted_member_ids cmi
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON cmi.member_id = m.member_id
LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON m.member_key = f.member_key 
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
